scope: Compact actual-evidence banking only, after the required upstream accepted executions; no semantic, production-output, MAIN, phone or future staging approval is independently supplied.
checks: Non-APPROVE semantic review, non-PASS build/reproduction, failed CTest or false retention/course predicates are refused.
All seven unique current outputs and both external seeds are bound as described in the correction record.
Only explicitly enumerated current-batch landing/caller/method-review and reproduction record/execution/method inputs are archived. Prior recursive review/reproduction source trees are not selected.
The running bank recorder has no execution.json until its subprocess returns; completed callers are included and the active caller is excluded.

Selected files must be regular non-symlink files with unique archive member names. Archive member order/names, complete extracted bytes and byte counts/hashes are verified against selected originals before readable manifest and PASS summary are written.
Seed is deliberately retained outside the archive, with external reproduction path and archived source/pin records. Core semantic/spec records remain ordinary banked files.
Summary states the existing MAIN/private-phone limits and explicitly leaves staging/commit/checkpoint evidence for later; it does not claim the future caller completion as an archive input.
limitations: This is implementation approval. The actual archive creation and byte verification remain unexecuted. One interrupted synthetic preflight harness attempt is preserved and explicitly not counted as a passing test.
